summary.text: 贵 is the simplified form of 貴. The traditional dictionary glosses 貴 as “not cheap,” and modern dictionaries include “expensive” and “valuable.” Its early construction has competing analyses.

formation.text: The traditional dictionary analyzes 貴 as a phonosemantic compound: 貝 contributes a money-related meaning, while 臾 supplies a sound cue. A competing account describes early forms as hands holding earth and assigns 中 the sound role. The early graphic analysis remains disputed.

components.text: In 貴, 貝 is treated as semantic: the historical dictionary describes it as a shell and says shells served as currency. This supports an association with money and value, but does not establish that the early graph pictured hands carrying a shell.

The traditional dictionary calls 臾 an ancient form of 蕢; a later study describes it as the protoform of 簣 and analyzes it as phonetic in 貴. These are distinct graphic-history claims. The study proposes Zhengzhang Shangfang Old Chinese *gruds for 臾 and *kluds for 貴. Their similar consonants and endings suggest a sound relationship, though reconstructed forms are not recorded ancient speech and the historical correspondence is not fully established.

sound_limitation.text: The cited analyses call 臾 phonetic, but do not provide a complete comparative series establishing its historical sound relation to 貴. The reported forms are reconstructions, not recorded ancient speech.

sound.text: A study proposes these Old Chinese forms in Zhengzhang Shangfang’s system. Their similar consonants and endings suggest a sound comparison; the same study reports a different reconstruction for 貴 in another system.

components.text: A competing account describes early forms as hands holding earth and assigns 中 the sound role, unlike the traditional dictionary’s analysis with 臾.

sound_limitation.text: The cited account calls 中 phonetic but gives no reading comparison establishing its sound relation to 貴.

history.text: The references present oracle-bone, bronze, seal, and standard forms, but their descriptions do not settle the details of the early graph. The later variant 䝿 is described as a regularization of a small-seal form; other transmitted spellings may reflect graphic distortion.
贵 is the simplified counterpart of 貴. The adoption date of this particular form remains unresolved.

uncertainties.text: The early graphic analysis is disputed: one account describes hands holding earth and assigns 中 the sound role, while the traditional dictionary and a scholarly analysis identify 貝 and 臾. These accounts do not resolve the original depiction or sound element.
The chronology connecting price, social rank, worth, esteem, and honor is not established by independently dated primary-text examples.

senses.text: A transmitted dictionary glosses 貴 as “not cheap”; current dictionary records also give “expensive” and “costly.” The dating of this sense in primary texts is unresolved.
Current dictionary records include “valuable” and “precious.” Their dating and whether they developed directly from “expensive” are unresolved.
Dictionary records include esteem, honor, and high social status. Their chronology and semantic path from the price sense are unresolved.

limitations.text: The transmitted gloss “not cheap” and current senses are supported, but a dated sequence among them is not. Reported classical examples have not been verified against primary texts.

overview.text: 贵 is the simplified form of 貴, glossed in a traditional dictionary as “not cheap”; today it commonly means “expensive” or “valuable.” The traditional graph is analyzed as a sound-and-meaning compound, though accounts differ about its early components.

components.text: In 貴, 貝 connects the graph with shells used as money and their association with value.
A study proposes 臾 *gruds and 貴 *kluds in the same reconstruction system. Their similar sounds support the proposed sound cue, though the analysis remains disputed.
An alternative account describes hands holding earth and assigns 中 the sound role; this analysis is disputed.

relationships.text: In the traditional dictionary analysis of 貴, 貝 contributes an association with money and value.
The traditional dictionary and scholarly analysis identify 臾 as the sound element in 貴; the competing early graphic analysis remains unresolved.
An alternative paleographic account assigns 中 the sound role in 貴, differing from the 臾 analysis.
贵 is the simplified form of 貴.
